precision_policy: Float32 throughout training and inference; cuDNN TF32 and CUDA matmul TF32 disabled. The earlier pilot exposed a batch/chunk precision discrepancy and is retained as a numerical diagnostic, excluded from these formal runs.
training_policy: Identical full-flight train/validation sources, maximum 100 epochs, early-stop patience 15, batch 4, Adam 0.001, and record/prefix/current losses 1/0.25/0.25. Actual epochs, updates, parameters and elapsed time are reported separately.
selection_policy: For each model and seed, select validation whole-record fixed-19 macro F1, break ties with record cross entropy. Event policy remains the same fixed defaults for both models; no test-based tuning.
test_policy: Freeze all six checkpoints, scalers, event policies, sources and code before reading historical test measurements. These already-exposed sources are a historical held-out comparison, not a new blind test.
scope: GAN-free full-flight baselines; one complete 2401x12 record is one classification sample; streaming memory is preserved; no window dataset or generated samples. Mean/std describe three training seeds, not additional independent flights.
